aspect: Banks act first and ask later
description: A name match triggers a hold, a review, or a closure. The institution's incentive is to act on a possible match, because the cost of a wrong closure falls entirely on the customer.
energy_note: Account frozen over a name you share.

aspect: Clearing it is not a thing you can do once
description: There is no central register to be removed from and no certificate of innocence to present. Each institution repeats the process independently, forever.
energy_note: Proving it again, at every new institution.

aspect: The commonest names carry the most risk
description: Because 10% of the leaked watchlist entries contain 'Muhammad', the most ordinary names in the population are the ones most exposed. Being unremarkable is the risk factor.
energy_note: Penalised for having an ordinary name.

description: Arabic naming convention runs first name, father's name, grandfather's name, family name. Systems built for four fields force two-part names to be split or duplicated; systems built for two reject four. Either way the stored name differs from the document, and every later comparison flags it.
energy_note: A name that does not fit the form in either direction.
